mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.product_id AS productId, i.quantity, i.version, p.name AS productName, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price, p.stock, p.status AS productStatus, c.name AS categoryName FROM cart_item i JOIN product p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.id
